snippet.title: WW2 Rebuilder: Caen And Remagen DLC - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
WW2 Rebuilder: Caen And Remagen DLC is out! 🎉🥳

The Remagen & Caen DLC takes you to iconic locations shaped by war and rebirth.
🌉 Remagen – where a single bridge changed the course of history.
🏙️ Caen – the heart of Normandy, rebuilt from the ground up after devastation.

Clear the ruins, restore key structures, and breathe life back into shattered cities with new tools, mechanics, and challenges. Every brick matters.

Build the future on the ashes of the past:
🔨 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140430/WW2_Rebuilder_Remagen_and_Caen_DLC
